title: LinkedIn Company Search Scraper

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Free-text company-search terms run against public LinkedIn company pages (e.g. 'fintech payments' or 'solar installer'). Combined with the other filters into one Google query. Defaults to empty. NOT a company URL — this searches for companies, it does not enrich a known page.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Industry or sector to match in the company page (e.g. 'Software Development' or 'Renewable Energy'). Quoted automatically so multi-word industries stay intact. Defaults to empty. NOT a free-form description — keep it to a short industry phrase.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region, or country the company is based in (e.g. 'San Francisco' or 'Berlin'). Used both in the search text and as the managed Google search geo hint. Defaults to empty. NOT a country code — use 'Country' for Google domain routing.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code used to route the Google domain and result language (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'de'). Defaults to 'us'. NOT a free-text country name — must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

maxResults.title: Max companies
maxResults.description: Maximum number of unique public company pages to return. Each company returned is billed as one 'company-found' event. Defaults to 25, max 500. Set lower to cap cost on exploratory searches.

enrich.title: Deep enrich each company
enrich.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrich.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
